A practical ward workflow

From observation to the right next step.

SafeWard helps make routine observations and clinical handoffs easier to see and measure.

01

Digital observations

Record and review vital-sign observations in a consistent ward workflow.

02

Early Warning Scores

Calculate scores using the observation protocol approved by the hospital.

03

Observation reminders

Make checks due or overdue visible to the nursing team.

04

Clinical escalation

Route attention to the responsible clinician and keep the handoff visible.

05

Ward dashboard

See patient status, pending observations, and escalation activity together.

01ObserveNurse records vital signs
02ReviewApproved EWS protocol applied
03RespondReminder or escalation routed
12-week pilot · one hospital ward

Start focused. Measure together.

Work alongside nursing and clinical leads, then review the results before deciding on expansion.

Weeks 1–201

Map & baseline

Work with nursing and clinical leads to map the ward workflow and record baseline measures.

Weeks 3–402

Configure & prepare

Set up the approved observation protocol, roles, reminders, and escalation paths; train the ward team.

Weeks 5–1003

Run the ward pilot

Use SafeWard in one ward with regular check-ins and support for the clinical team.

Weeks 11–1204

Review & decide

Review the results with hospital leads and decide whether expansion is appropriate.

Evaluate the pilot against: Observation completion Escalation timeliness Doctor response
Part of the SmartCare IoMT ecosystem

Useful without AI. Ready to connect.

SafeWard’s core workflow is digital observations, the hospital-approved EWS, reminders, and escalation. Optional analytics can be added later when data quality, clinical governance, and the hospital’s needs support it. AI does not replace clinician review.
